w10_T4_001331: Ada saves 170 cents every day from her paper round, and her father adds the same again so that her daily saving is doubled. She gives half of each day's saving to her sister. The bank is 2 kilometres from her house. She keeps this up for 5 days, and then spends 771 cents on a book. At the fair every cent she has left buys 4 tokens, and every token is worth 4 points on the ring toss. How many points can Ada score?
w10_T4_001343: In the morning a grocer received 23 crates. Each crate held 9 boxes, and each box held 9 oranges. In the afternoon he sold 371 oranges. In the evening a farmer dropped off 63 oranges, and then a neighbour brought 11 more. How many oranges did the grocer have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_001346: In the morning Bo had 38 tomato plants in his greenhouse and sold 24 of them. He waters his plants twice a day. Each plant he kept gave him 8 tomatoes. In the afternoon his friend Cy, who had picked fewer tomatoes than Bo, gave him 34 tomatoes. In the evening Bo sold every tomato he had for 5 cents each. How many cents did Bo receive?
w10_T4_001348: Dee planned 195 minutes of study per session, more than three hours, but she cut 147 minutes from every session. She studies 3 sessions a day, 7 days a week, and keeps this up for 7 weeks. On the last day she adds a 55-minute revision session. How many minutes does Dee study in total?
w10_T4_001355: A pack of 150 stickers was shared equally among 3 cousins. Eli then got 17 more stickers from a magazine. His grandmother gave him twice as many stickers as he had, doubling his collection. Eli is 8 years old. He lost 1 sticker and gave 20 to a classmate. In the school sticker contest every sticker is worth 4 points. How many points does Eli score?
w10_T4_001356: A school club had 134 dollars in its account and spent 29 dollars on badges. The rest was shared equally among its 5 sections. The club has 40 members. The art section spent 15 dollars on paint. A sponsor then gave the art section 3 dollars for every dollar it had left, and the section also received a 71-dollar grant. How many dollars does the art section have now?
w10_T4_001360: Fay keeps her coins in a jar. She started with 39 cents, then added 70 cents from her grandmother, 38 cents from selling old comics, and 79 cents from returning bottles. She then split the money equally between 2 jars, a blue one and a red one. How many cents are in the blue jar?
w10_T4_001363: In the morning Gil had 90 cents. He spent 27 cents on a bun and 42 cents on juice. In the afternoon his aunt gave him twice what he had, doubling his money, and at the arcade every cent bought him 4 tokens. He spent 82 tokens on games, while his friend Hal had fewer tokens than Gil. In the evening the arcade gave 3 free plays for every token that Gil still had. How many free plays did Gil get?
w10_T4_001367: A quarry loads 225 kilograms of stone in each scoop, and a truck takes 9 scoops. Each truck also carries 74 kilograms of gravel. The quarry runs 3 trucks, each making one trip a day, for 5 days, with a half-hour break at noon. The quarry is 6 kilometres from town. On the last day 52 kilograms of stone are added by hand. How many kilograms does the quarry send out altogether?
w10_T4_001369: Ivy earns 123 cents an hour at the bakery, where she has worked for a dozen years. She works 5 hours a day for 7 days. The bakery opens at 6. She then spends 3482 cents on a train fare and 466 cents on lunch. How many cents does Ivy have left?
w10_T4_001371: Jax runs on a loop of 182 metres and does 4 loops in each session, then jogs 32 metres to cool down. He trains twice a week, and completed 8 sessions this month. His friend Kim runs less than Jax. On the last day he also ran 24 metres to catch a bus. How many metres did Jax run this month?
w10_T4_001384: In the morning Lin sold 8 cups of tea at 16 cents each and received a 24-cent tip. She spent 148 cents on a sandwich. In the afternoon her friend Mo, who had earned less than Lin that day, paid her back 39 cents, and then she spent 9 cents on a stamp. In the evening her grandmother gave her 4 cents for every cent she had. How many cents does Lin have now?
w10_T4_001386: A pantry shelf held 147 jars of jam. The cook made 50 more jars and put them on the shelf. She then sold 44 jars at the fair. A neighbour gave her 40 jars, and later she found 6 jars in a cupboard and added them to the shelf. How many jars are on the shelf now?
w10_T4_001388: Nell had 80 raffle tickets. She gave 22 tickets to her cousin Oz, who then had fewer tickets than Nell. She sold each of her remaining tickets for 7 cents. She spent 299 cents on lunch. At the fair every cent she had left earned her 9 points, and she then spent 929 points on a prize. How many points does Nell have left?
w10_T4_001393: In the morning a bakery had 83 loaves. It sold 65 loaves, and 3 were burnt and thrown away. Each remaining loaf was cut into 3 pieces. The oven was set to 220 degrees. In the afternoon 28 pieces were sold, and a neighbouring stall sent over 53 pieces. In the evening every piece was sold for 9 cents. How many cents did the bakery take in the evening?
w10_T4_001400: Pia earns 159 cents a day walking dogs and 72 cents a day feeding cats, and she saves it all. Her friend Quin, who works half as many hours, earns less each day than Pia. Pia saves like this for 3 days. She then receives 74 cents from her aunt and 22 cents from her uncle. She spends 550 cents on a lead for her own dog. How many cents does Pia have left?
w10_T4_001401: In the morning Rae and Sol picked 7 rows of strawberries with 103 berries in each row. In the afternoon they picked 45 more from a wild patch. They shared all the berries equally between the 2 of them, so Rae's share was exactly the same as Sol's. In the evening Rae ate 43 of her berries. How many berries does Rae have left?
w10_T4_001403: A cyclist takes 172 seconds for each lap of the track, a little under three minutes. She rides 8 laps in a set and 5 sets in a session, and completed 6 sessions this week. The track has a dozen bends. Her club has 15 riders. Her total time was shared equally between 3 relay teams. How many seconds were given to the red team?
w10_T4_001406: In the morning a warehouse held 28 crates, and 7 were shipped out. Then 23 crates arrived. In the afternoon the manager opened every crate and found 2 boxes in each, and every box held 5 bags. The warehouse has 6 doors. In the evening the bags were weighed at 8 kilograms each. How many kilograms did all the bags weigh?
w10_T4_001408: A charity had 156 minutes of phone calls to make, more than two and a half hours, and shared the work equally among 3 volunteers. Tam received her share, and then 17 minutes of calls were added to her list. Her friend Uli finished his calls sooner than Tam. Tam spread her calls equally over 3 days. On Monday she added 59 minutes of extra calls, and then 23 minutes of her Monday calls were cancelled. How many minutes of calls did Tam make on Monday?
w10_T4_001409: In the morning Van earned 67 cents an hour at the stall plus 63 cents an hour in tips, and he worked 5 hours. In the afternoon he counted that he would work exactly the same on each of 6 days, which came to thirty-nine dollars. A customer added 28 cents. In the evening he spent 3102 cents on a coat. How many cents does Van have left?
w10_T4_001411: A honey farm fills 201 grams of honey into every jar, with 6 jars in a box and 4 boxes in a crate. It sent 3 crates to a shop after half a day of packing. It also sent a 41-gram sample jar. How many grams of honey did the farm send?
w10_T4_001413: Vera earns 211 cents for each shift at the cafe and worked 4 shifts this week. She spent 502 cents on groceries. Her friend Wes, who earns less per shift than Vera, paid her back 48 cents. The cafe then gave her 8 loyalty points for every cent she had. How many loyalty points did Vera get?
w10_T4_001418: A school had 122 chairs in its hall. It bought 56 more chairs and borrowed 20 from a church. The hall is 30 metres long. Each chair weighs 8 kilograms. All the chairs were loaded equally onto 4 vans for a fair. How many kilograms of chairs were on the first van?
w10_T4_001420: A seed company packs 202 seeds in every packet, with 5 packets in a box, and a farmer bought 8 boxes. She checks her fields twice a week. She divided the seeds equally among her 4 plots. In the first plot she also sowed 59 seeds saved from last year. Every seed in that plot grew into a plant with 9 peas. How many peas did the first plot produce?
